wiki.title: Sasha Renée Pérez
wiki.extract: Sasha Renée Pérez (born September 16, 1992) is an American politician who is a member of the California State Senate for the 25th district. A Democrat, she is the youngest State Senator in California. Pérez previously served as mayor and city councilor of Alhambra.
